'';\n                    if (ticket)\n                        typingTicketCache.set(userId, ticket);\n                }\n                if (ticket) {\n                    await sendTyping(account.token, userId, ticket, 1, account.baseUrl);\n                }\n            }\n            catch {\n                // typing 失败不阻塞\n            }\n            // 清理 Markdown 并分段发送（第一段带引用回复）\n            const plainText = stripMarkdown(content);\n            const chunks = chunkText(plainText, 3900);\n            for (let i = 0; i < chunks.length; i++) {\n                const refId = i === 0 ? replyToMessageId : undefined;\n                await sendMessage(account.token, userId, chunks[i], contextToken, account.baseUrl, refId);\n            }\n            // 发送媒体文件（如有）\n            let mediaError = '';\n            if (media) {\n                try {\n                    await uploadMedia({\n                        token: account.token,\n                        toUser: userId,\n                        contextToken,\n                        filePath: media,\n                        baseUrl: account.baseUrl,\n                    });\n                }\n                catch (err) {\n                    mediaError = `（媒体发送失败: ${String(err)}）`;\n                }\n            }\n            // 停止 typing 状态（best-effort）\n            try {\n                const ticket = typingTicketCache.get(userId);\n                if (ticket) {\n                    await sendTyping(account.token, userId, ticket, 2, account.baseUrl);\n                }\n            }\n            catch {\n                // typing 失败不阻塞\n            }\n            return {\n                content: [{\n                        type: 'text',\n                        text: `已发送 ${chunks.length} 段文本${media ? resp.ret ?? 0;\n                if (errcode === SESSION_EXPIRED_ERRCODE) {\n                    sessionRetries++;\n                    process.stderr.write(`[wechat-channel] Session 过期 (${sessionRetries}/${MAX_SESSION_RETRIES})\\n`);\n                    if (sessionRetries >= MAX_SESSION_RETRIES) {\n                        pollingActive = false;\n                        // 通知 Claude session 过期\n                        server.notification({\n                            method: 'notifications/message',\n                            params: {\n                                level: 'error',\n                                data: 'WeChat session expired, please use login tool to reconnect',\n                            },\n                        });\n                        return;\n                    }\n                    await sleep(SESSION_PAUSE_MS, pollingAbort?.signal);\n                    continue;\n                }\n                // 其他错误\n                consecutiveFailures++;\n                process.stderr.write(`[wechat-channel] API 错误 errcode=${errcode} errmsg=${resp.errmsg ?? ''),\n                            session_id: msg.session_id ?? '',\n                        },\n                    },\n                });\n            }\n        }\n        catch (err) {\n            if (pollingAbort?.signal.aborted)\n                return;\n `(${consecutiveFailures}/${MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES})\\n`);\n            if (consecutiveFailures >= MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES) {\n                process.stderr.write(`[wechat-channel] 连续失败过多，暂停 '',\n                botId: result.accountId,\n                savedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            });\n            startPolling();\n            return {\n                content: [{ type: 'text', text: `登录成功！账号 ID: ${result.accountId}` }],\n            };\n        }\n        catch (err) {\n            return {\n                content: [{ type: 'text', text: `登录失败: ${String(err)}` }],\n                isError: true,\n            };\n        }\n    }\n    // ── reply tool ──\n    if (name === 'reply') {\n        const userId = args?.user_id;\n        const contextToken = args?.context_token;\n        const content = args?.content;\n        const media = args?.media;\n        const replyToMessageId = args?.reply_to_message_id;\n        // 验证必填参数\n        if (!userId || !contextToken || !content) {\n            return {\n                content: [{ type: 'text', text: '缺少必填参数: user_id, context_token, content' }],\n                isError: true,\n            };\n        }\n        // 验证账号存在\n        const account = getActiveAccount();\n        if (!account) {\n            return {\n                content: [{ type: 'text', text: '未登录，请先使用 login 工具扫码登录' }],\n                isError: true,\n            };\n        }\n        // 检查媒体文件是否存在\n        if (media && !fs.existsSync(media)) {\n            return {\n                content: [{ type: 'text', text: `媒体文件不存在: ${media}` }],\n                isError: true,\n            };\n        }\n        try {\n            // 发送 typing 状态（best-effort）\n            try {\n                let ticket = typingTicketCache.get(userId);\n                if (!ticket) {\n                    const config = await getConfig(account.token, userId, contextToken, account.baseUrl);\n                    ticket = config.typing_ticket ?? '';\n                    if (ticket)\n                        typingTicketCache.set(userId, ticket);\n                }\n                if (ticket) {\n                    await sendTyping(account.token, userId, ticket, 1, account.baseUrl);\n                }\n            }\n            catch {\n                // typing 失败不阻塞\n            }\n            // 清理 Markdown 并分段发送（第一段带引用回复）\n            const plainText = stripMarkdown(content);\n            const chunks = chunkText(plainText, 3900);\n            for (let i = 0; i < chunks.length; i++) {\n                const refId = i === 0 ? replyToMessageId : undefined;\n                await sendMessage(account.token, userId, chunks[i], contextToken, account.baseUrl, refId);\n            }\n            // 发送媒体文件（如有）\n            let mediaError = '';\n            if (media) {\n                try {\n                    await uploadMedia({\n                        token: account.token,\n                        toUser: userId,\n                        contextToken,\n                        filePath: media,\n                        baseUrl: account.baseUrl,\n                    });\n                }\n                catch (err) {\n                    mediaError = `（媒体发送失败: ${String(err)}）`;\n                }\n            }\n            // 停止 typing 状态（best-effort）\n            try {\n                const ticket = typingTicketCache.get(userId);\n                if (ticket) {\n                    await sendTyping(account.token, userId, ticket, 2, account.baseUrl);\n                }\n            }\n            catch {\n                // typing 失败不阻塞\n            }\n            return {\n                content: [{\n                        type: 'text',\n                        text: `已发送 ${chunks.length} 段文本${media ? resp.ret ?? 0;\n                if (errcode === SESSION_EXPIRED_ERRCODE) {\n                    sessionRetries++;\n                    process.stderr.write(`[wechat-channel] Session 过期 (${sessionRetries}/${MAX_SESSION_RETRIES})\\n`);\n                    if (sessionRetries >= MAX_SESSION_RETRIES) {\n                        pollingActive = false;\n                        // 通知 Claude session 过期\n                        server.notification({\n                            method: 'notifications/message',\n                            params: {\n                                level: 'error',\n                                data: 'WeChat session expired, please use login tool to reconnect',\n                            },\n                        });\n                        return;\n                    }\n                    await sleep(SESSION_PAUSE_MS, pollingAbort?.signal);\n                    continue;\n                }\n                // 其他错误\n                consecutiveFailures++;\n                process.stderr.write(`[wechat-channel] API 错误 errcode=${errcode} errmsg=${resp.errmsg ?? ''} ` +\n                    `(${consecutiveFailures}/${MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES})\\n`);\n                if (consecutiveFailures >= MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES) {\n                    process.stderr.write(`[wechat-channel] 连续失败过多，暂停 ${SESSION_PAUSE_MS / 1000}s\\n`);\n                    await sleep(SESSION_PAUSE_MS, pollingAbort?.signal);\n                    consecutiveFailures = 0;\n                }\n                else {\n                    await sleep(retryDelay, pollingAbort?.signal);\n                    retryDelay = Math.min(retryDelay * 2, MAX_RETRY_DELAY_MS);\n                }\n                continue;\n            }\n            // 成功 → 重置计数器\n            consecutiveFailures = 0;\n            retryDelay = INITIAL_RETRY_DELAY_MS;\n            // 保存 sync buf\n            if (resp.get_updates_buf) {\n                buf = resp.get_updates_buf;\n                saveSyncBuf(buf);\n            }\n            // 处理消息（仅用户消息 message_type === 1）\n            for (const msg of resp.msgs ?? `(${consecutiveFailures}/${MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES})\\n`);\n            if (consecutiveFailures >= MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES) {\n                process.stderr.write(`[wechat-channel] 连续失败过多，暂停 true;\n    pollingAbort = new AbortController();\n    pollLoop(account).catch((err) => {\n        if (!pollingAbort?.signal.aborted) {\n            process.stderr.write(`[wechat-channel] Poll loop
